arguments.query: SELECT status, count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status
SELECT count(*), sum(delivered_ts IS NULL), sum(shipped_ts IS NULL), min(shipped_ts), max(shipped_ts), min(delivered_ts), max(delivered_ts) FROM shipments

SELECT carrier, count(*), round(avg(julianday(delivered_ts)-julianday(shipped_ts)),2), min(julianday(delivered_ts)-julianday(shipped_ts)), max(julianday(delivered_ts)-julianday(shipped_ts)) FROM shipments WHERE delivered_ts IS NOT NULL GROUP BY carrier
SELECT cast(julianday(delivered_ts)-julianday(shipped_ts) as int) d, count(*) FROM shipments WHERE delivered_ts IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d
SELECT count(*), round(100.0*avg(julianday(delivered_ts)-julianday(shipped_ts)<=3),2) FROM shipments WHERE delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND shipped_ts>="2025-01-01" AND shipped_ts<"2026-01-01"
